resources.string: Shows pinyin above Chinese text when you tap the accessibility button.

When you tap the accessibility button or the Rubify Quick Settings tile, Rubify takes a screenshot, recognizes the Chinese characters in it and shows their pinyin above them, with a small bubble to refresh, hide or close the pinyin. When started from the tile, Rubify first closes the Quick Settings panel. Rubify acts only when you tap. It does not read screen content at any other time, and screenshots are processed on this device and never uploaded.
Rubify shows pinyin above Chinese characters on your screen. Enable the Rubify accessibility service, then tap the accessibility button whenever you want pinyin for what is on screen.
Rubify needs your consent before you turn it on.

Is Rubify greyed out in accessibility settings? Android blocks accessibility for apps installed from a download until you allow it: open App info, tap the ⋮ menu, then Allow restricted settings. Then turn Rubify on again.
In full-screen apps the accessibility button is hidden. Use the Rubify tile in Quick Settings instead.
Rubify uses an Android accessibility service to show pinyin above Chinese text in any app. Please read how it works before you turn it on.

When you tap the accessibility button, the Rubify Quick Settings tile, or Refresh on Rubify\'s floating bubble, Rubify takes a screenshot, finds the Chinese characters in it and draws their pinyin on top of the screen. When you start it from the tile, it first closes the Quick Settings panel.
Only the image of your screen at the moment you tap. That image can include personal information that is visible on screen, such as messages or names.
Rubify never looks at your screen on its own. It does not track what you do in other apps, cannot read or operate their text and buttons, and does not change your settings.
Screenshots are processed on this device and discarded once the pinyin is drawn. Rubify does not store, collect or share any personal data, and it has no internet access.
You have agreed to this. You can withdraw your consent at any time; Rubify then stops reading the screen until you agree again. To turn the service off completely, use accessibility settings.
